question: What arises when one knows the hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature yields all-knowingness.
The verse states arising of sarvajñatvam.
Taṃ refers to hidden true nature.
inference: Knowledge of the concealed true nature produces omniscience.
uncertainties: Exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context.
Middle-voice nuance of prajāyate is not fully specified.
plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
